name: get_current_location
description: Get the current location of the user.

name: get_current_date
description: Get the current local date and timezone for resolving relative travel dates.

name: resolve_city_transport_nodes
description: Find local airport transport nodes for a city from the local IATA database.

city.description: City name, for example London or Paris.

name: search_flights
description: Search local demo flight candidates between two cities on a concrete travel date.

travel_date.description: Concrete ISO travel date, for example 2026-05-30.

max_results.description: Maximum number of candidates to return.

name: plan_trip_transport
description: Build compact round-trip transport options using concrete ISO dates chosen by the LLM.

outbound_date.description: Concrete ISO outbound date chosen by the LLM, for example 2026-05-30.

return_date.description: Concrete ISO return date chosen by the LLM, for example 2026-05-31.

origin_city.description: Optional origin city. If omitted, the user's current location is used.

max_options.description: Maximum number of round-trip transport options to return.

name: search_pois
description: Search local hotel, restaurant, attraction, entertainment, transport, mall, or resting-area POI candidates from the mock POI database.

query.description: Optional fuzzy search text, such as Wagas, hotpot, hotel, park, or a POI name.

category.description: Optional POI category: restaurant, hotel, attraction, mall, entertainment, transport, or resting_area.

district.description: Optional district id: riverfront_leisure, cbd_business, or mall_entertainment.

price_level.description: Optional price level: low, medium, or high.

open_at.description: Optional local HH:MM time; only return POIs open at that time when hours are parseable.

max_results.description: Maximum number of candidates to return.

name: fuzzy_search
description: Fuzzy-align user text to bounded local candidates across cities, airports, and POIs. Returns matched, ambiguous, context_override, or no_match status.

query.description: User text to match, such as Paris, CDG, Wagas, hotel, hotpot, park, or a POI name.

kind.description: Optional target kind: city, airport, or poi.

itinerary_cities.description: Cities already present in the itinerary context.

top_k.description: Maximum number of fuzzy candidates to return.

name: get_poi_details
description: Get detailed local POI data by id, for example RB005 or poi:RB005.

poi_id.description: POI id, with or without the poi: prefix.

name: get_replacement_pois
description: Get replacement candidates for an existing POI, optionally filtered by trigger event such as rainy, traffic_delay, or cheaper.

poi_id.description: Original POI id, with or without the poi: prefix.

trigger_event.description: Optional trigger event: rainy, traffic_delay, cheaper, budget_change, or other free text.

max_results.description: Maximum number of replacement candidates to return.

name: plan_trip_with_local_data
description: Build round-trip transport options plus local hotel, restaurant, activity, and entertainment candidates from existing local datasets.

outbound_date.description: Concrete ISO outbound date chosen by the LLM, for example 2026-05-30.

return_date.description: Concrete ISO return date chosen by the LLM, for example 2026-05-31.

origin_city.description: Optional origin city. If omitted, the user's current location is used.

max_transport_options.description: Maximum number of round-trip transport options to return.

max_poi_candidates.description: Maximum number of candidates per local data category.
